journey.name: Text Note Capture to Library
journey.description: Verify issue #4: Capture hub creates a text note, Library lists it, editor edits and saves.

actions.action: Tap Capture in the bottom navigation
Verify "New text note", "Title (optional)", and "Body" are visible
Enter "Grocery list" in the Title (optional) field
Enter "Milk and eggs" in the Body field
Verify the Library screen is shown
Enter "Milk, eggs, bread" in the Body field
Verify "Grocery list" is visible in Library
